scope: Frozen GRU was previously trained on both decoder-fit and decoder-selection, and fixed feature/state normalization uses former TRAIN. Selection is therefore head-level transfer selection, not an end-to-end independent GRU holdout. Confirmation excludes GRU/head training and current head checkpoint selection, but its outcomes were examined in earlier development experiments and are not pristine. The base GRU checkpoint was itself selected on this former validation set; this is not an untouched complete-pipeline holdout.
cpu_cuda_tolerance: 0.2% relative for state MAE/objective; startup p90 absolute0.002. Discrete near-tied peak timing can differ.
